claims.text: The USAF's 'Case Closed' prints Gerald Anderson's interview in full as Appendix C, beginning at page 187, noting it was 'excerpted in their entirety from unedited interviews used to prepare the video, Recollections of Roswell, Part II (1993)' and appears courtesy of the Fund for UFO Research. The Air Force also quotes him directly on the alleged bodies: 'I thought they were plastic dolls.'

edges.label: The Air Force reports were produced to rebut Marcel's account
edges.note: Marcel's 1978 recantation restarted the case; the 1994-1997 Air Force volumes exist because of it and conclude against him, attributing the debris to Project MOGUL and reported bodies to test dummies.
